resources.string: Text, reactions, edits and quotes are encrypted on your phone. Only the devices in the chat can open them.
Photos, videos, voice messages and files
Encrypted before upload. The server does not know file names or types, only the size.
Audio and video travel between the phones encrypted. The server only helps the phones find each other.
Encrypted with your recovery key. The key never leaves your phone.
Files go from phone to phone. Not a single byte is stored on the server.
Passed along encrypted and never saved.
Registration needs only a username and a password.
The address book is never uploaded.
Not written to the database. Used for up to one hour to limit sign-in attempts.
Username, display name, bio and avatar. The people you talk to see them too.
Only a hash. The password itself is not kept.
Name, platform, Android and app versions, time of last activity and the notification token.
Who you talk to and when
Chat members, the time and size of every message, delivery and read marks. The read time is recorded even if you hide read receipts.
That a message was edited, deleted, answered or got a reaction, and by whom. Never what it says.
Recorded even when hidden. The setting only decides who may see it.
Who called whom, when and for how long. Removing a call from your history hides it but does not erase it on the server.
Privacy choices, blocked accounts, muted, pinned and archived chats.
Until you clear the chat, delete a message for everyone or delete the account. Delete for me removes only your copy.
30 days, with the screenshots you attach.
24 hours, and only if you turn it on.
A notification carries no text and no sender name, only technical identifiers.
Can see your profile and devices, suspend or delete the account and issue a recovery code. The admin panel cannot open messages or your list of chats.
Notes that a message was sent, by whom and to which chat. Never the content.
UNYRI can run on a server that belongs to you. Then all of this stays with you.
Messages, files and calls are encrypted on your phone before they leave it. This is the full list: what the server cannot read, what it does not have at all, and what it does keep.
This list is checked against the server code and is updated whenever the server changes what it keeps.
